title: Lowpoly Mesh Rename And Transform Fix
description: Rename object to mesh in lowpoly UI/selection. Fix face move moving whole mesh. Fix missing window options.
summary: Renamed lowpoly selection mode object→mesh in UI, fixture schema, and Rust session. Face/edge/vertex gumball transforms now move only selected components via selection_vertex_ids + rotate_vertices/scale_vertices in mesh kernel. Window engagement shows persistent options (Move, Rotate, Scale, Snap, Smooth) with sessionActive and syncWindowEngagement on selection changes. Gumball centroid uses selectionCentroid for component modes.
